provenance.method: Project-authored candidate lexical inventory extracted from exact positive fixture tokens in the immutable USG-INTERPRET-GOLD/0.3.0 corpus; no external dictionary claims; every entry carries source fixture spans.
limitations: Only forms observed in positive benchmark fixtures are included.
Lexical senses are candidate links, not approved definitions or runtime disambiguation.
Predicate-head and grammatical-marker spans are lexical evidence, not semantic participant roles.
No root-pattern Arabic morphological generator is implied.
